name: Nonprofit Grant Opportunity Scoring & Review - Public Template

parameters.content:
## Nonprofit Grant Opportunity Scoring & Review - Public Template

### How it works

This workflow reviews nonprofit grant opportunities from a Google Sheets queue, either when run manually or when new queue rows appear. It validates each opportunity, loads the organization profile and existing grant records, checks for duplicates, then scores eligible grants and generates a recommendation. Final scored opportunities are saved to a grant records sheet, while duplicate, validation-error, and processed statuses are written back to the queue.

### Setup steps

- Connect Google Sheets credentials for all Sheets trigger, read, append, and update nodes.
- Configure the grant queue spreadsheet and sheet/tab used by the manual load, queue trigger, and queue status update nodes.
- Configure the organization profile and existing/scored grant records spreadsheets referenced by the lookup and save nodes.
- Review the Code nodes to ensure required fields, scoring criteria, duplicate checks, and recommendation logic match your nonprofit’s data structure.

### Customization

Adjust validation rules, duplicate matching criteria, fit-scoring weights, recommendation thresholds, and the queue status labels to match your organization’s grant review process.

## Grant intake sources

Starts the workflow either manually by loading new grant opportunities from Google Sheets or automatically from the grant queue trigger.

## Validate incoming grants

Runs validation logic on incoming grant rows and routes valid grants onward or invalid grants to an error update path.

## Load reference records

Loads the nonprofit organization profile and existing grant records needed for scoring and duplicate detection.

## Record validation failures

Prepares validation error details and updates the grant queue row to mark invalid opportunities.

## Detect duplicate grants

Compares the current opportunity against existing grant records and routes duplicate versus new opportunities.

## Mark duplicate grants

Builds the duplicate status payload and writes duplicate grant information back to Google Sheets.

## Score and recommend

Scores the grant fit, checks whether organization profile data is available, generates a recommendation when possible, or prepares a profile-related validation error from the same scoring cluster.

## Save scored grant

Formats the final grant record and saves the scored opportunity to the grant records sheet.

## Update processed status

Prepares and writes the processed status back to the queue after the scored grant has been saved.
